case.subject: Hospital for Special Surgery insurance appeals
case.problem: Manual processing of insurance claims appeals was time-consuming, taking 45 minutes per case.
case.workflow: The AI agent gathers required information from disparate systems, completes routine appeal tasks, and follows up automatically when a case stalls.
case.result: Appeals processing time reduced from 45 minutes to 5 minutes, with success rates improving from 65% to 100% for the 1,100 claims handled monthly.
case.result_basis: Reported production outcome confirmed by the hospital's chief digital and technology officer.
case.measurement_context: Comparison of manual processing times and appeal success rates before and after agent deployment.
case.source_quote: reducing appeals processing from 45 minutes to just 5 minutes and improving success rates from 65% to 100%
case.limitation: Success depends on clean data and proper process design; the underlying workflow must be sound before automation to avoid faster errors.
case.listener_action: Audit your current manual claim-appeal process to identify exactly where information gathering stalls; do not automate until the manual steps are clearly defined.
